messages.subject: Shiny and Dropbox
parts:
Dear group members
I just recently joined the Shiny family and was quite successfull to create some very nive apps. However, now I have a problem which I cannot solve even after thoroughly searching the net. I create a shiny app and a dataset which work quite nicely on my computer. The same app also works when I deploy the app including the dataset to the io server. I now want however used dropbox for updating the data which are shown in the app on a daily basis. I have registered my dropbox account in R and I am able to create the datafile on my dropbox account. Again, when I run the app on my local machine and use the dropbox folder as data storage all works perfectly. As soon as I upload the app to the io.server the app starts and then says "Disconnected from server" and no data appear. My app has the following code for reading the data from the drobox.

#Server section =================
server <- function(input, output) {
  message("in shinyServer")
  token <- readRDS("droptoken.rds")
  drop_acc(dtoken = token)

  svl_par_all_avg_hour <- drop_read_csv("shiny/data/svl_par_all.csv")
  svl_par_all_avg_hour$datetime <-as.POSIXct(svl_par_all_avg_hour$datetime)

I have deployed the droptoken.rds file on the io server and also .httr-oauth are on the folder where the app is created.

Has anybody a clue why the app disconnects from the server whithout reading the data?

Thanks a lot for any help.

All the best
Philipp
